ce_bugs.text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:158 — EventManager is built from the *caller's* credentials (getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)) instead of the booking organizer's (fetched at line 34 and never used), so when an attendee or team owner adds guests the calendar update targets the wrong account and silently no-ops.
